body:
I bought an ounce online.  I heard it would make me hear differently, make my sight go all 70's porno, etc.
I just got tired after a couple hours, didn't wait around for effects.  I just felt WAY too tired from it. I had to work the next day, strenuous Post Office work.
When I woke up, EVERY muscle ached, my HEART, arms, legs, even my eyeballs and tongue.  I overdid it.
I overdid it.
I had read it was a mild anti-cholinergenic.  I figured I HAD to sick out, or I'd have a heart attack.  I felt like an 80 year old man.  WORST drug I have ever taken.
It ended costing me over 80 bucks in the end, missing work and all.  I'll probably never take it again, unless it's less.
I was naive and stuff, didn't think it would be so bad taking that much.
[Reported Dose: "1/2 to 1 ounce made into tea"]
